card.name: Words inside fixed boxed-warning sentences
card.fires_on: The word "with" in "not approved for ... patients with dementia-related psychosis", and "recommended" in "even at recommended dosages". These appear in stock warning text in drug labels.

modes.label: Dementia psychosis warning
modes.description: The word "with" right before "dementia-related psychosis" in the antipsychotic boxed warning.
modes.example: REXULTI is not approved for the treatment of patients<< with>> dementia-related psychosis without agitation associated with dementia
